answer: Random mentor liability: every new agent is paired by a public randomness beacon with one established mentor it cannot choose. The mentor co-signs its first epochs and posts a small bond that is slashed if the newcomer is later proven a clone. Because a farm cannot pick its own mentors, each fake must fool an independent stranger, a prism splitting one operator into many visible risks. Honest mentors earn a cut, so the atlas of trust grows outward instead of a lone tundra of unvetted keys.
